english: A solar array tuned by kitsune hands. Each solar cell makes 25 times the vanilla power, so six good cells put out up to 4500W by day. Free power for the whole base while the sun is up. Needs solar cells to run.

A generator bank that never leaves you short. Each engine makes 7.5 times the vanilla power (up to 4500W with six good engines), every can of gas goes twice as far, and the tank holds 4.5 times as much. Your anytime power source when the sun is down. Needs small engines and gas to run.

The heart of the chain. Stores power from solar and generator banks in the car batteries you slot in. Each bit of charge holds twice the vanilla power, so batteries fill twice as fast and last twice as long, and six good batteries put out up to 4500W. Needs car batteries to run.
Context / Alternate Text: runs your whole base. Conversion stays honest: faster
